'''mc9457 Black Sun Scum''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mc9457]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 AOBS mc9457 DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Black Sun & Scum...mmm...gravy...Pre Tatooine deck...another fun deck

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck works similarly to any other Scum deck.  Track a Tatooine: Jabba's
Palace into hand turn 1 or 2 (especially easy when using the 7 side of the
objective).  Deploy, fetch the Audience Chamber and start draining at T: DB
+ JP sites.  None Shall Pass will keep Rebels away, aliens can be barriered.
Most aliens on their own will not be able to draw destiny (thanks to Xixor),
meaning character elimination via Trample is going to be key.  Major
retreival using Scum+First Strike.  Search and Destroy+Vigos+Vengeance will
make short work of any deck.  No Emperor?  Yup - negates Scum.  Bad bad man.
Don't need the destiny anyways.  Interrupts take care of most of it, with a
flipped objective adding to the attrition making most characters go away
very easily.  Luke is the biggest obsticle to this deck, especially Luke
Skywalker, "The Machine" Jedi Knight causing most of the headaches.  Biggest
problem is immunity to attrition.  How do you cancel it?  4LOM with
gun/Release Your Anger.  Biggest worry is going to be Profit (which will let
you flip first turn), Agents, and Watch Your Step.  Agents typically play Bo
Shuda, hurting your chances of draining at the AC.  Profit also presents a
drain at the AC, but flipping the objective early is nice.  WYS - just that
annoying interrupt play from lost pile as well as the multiple destinies.
Might be worth it to play a few Wounded Wookies, although Jodo+Guri will
help.
